{
  "name": "FML",
  "version": "0.0.1",
  "description": "Fml Open Ide",
  "dependencies": {
    "@antv/layout": "^0.1.24",
    "@antv/x6": "^1.29.1",
    "antd": "^4.18.2",
    "antlr4ts": "^0.5.0-alpha.3",
    "monaco-editor-core": "^0.18.1",
    "react": "^16.8.6",
    "react-dom": "^16.8.6"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "start": "webpack-dev-server --hot --open",
    "build": "webpack --mode production",
    "antlr4ts": "antlr4ts -visitor ./antlr/FastModelLexer.g4 ./antlr/FastModelGrammarParser.g4 -o ./src/"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/react": "^16.8.12",
    "@types/react-dom": "^16.8.3",
    "antlr4ts-cli": "^0.5.0-alpha.3",
    "css-loader": "^3.3.0",
    "html-webpack-plugin": "^3.2.0",
    "moment": "^2.29.1",
    "style-loader": "^1.0.1",
    "ts-loader": "^5.3.3",
    "typescript": "^3.4.2",
    "webpack": "^4.29.6",
    "webpack-cli": "^3.3.0",
    "webpack-dev-server": "^3.2.1"
  }
}

CREATE TABLE public.users (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    email VARCHAR(255),
    age INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT now()
);
